title: progressive pause settle to full res

commit.merge_subject: merge: progressive pause settle to full res

tests: Kotlin-only change (no core/ or JNI touch). JVM tests: 483 pass,
description:
Pause and clip end previously issued ONE full-resolution
(SOURCE_MAX_DIM) render, leaving the coarse 720px playback frame
on screen for the whole develop (~400-500ms/frame on the Xiaomi
15 Ultra for 4K RGGB; desktop stage measurements: demosaic
143.6ms + ARGB pack 106.9ms dominate the 303.1ms neutral total,
the 22-stage pipeline already skips neutral stages 7-22).

Now the pause lands progressively: a fast 1280px (PAUSED_MAX_DIM)
intermediate first (~9x cheaper than the full-res develop; the
seek tier already measured instant at this resolution), then a
full-res follow-up replaces it, hiding most of the pause latency
behind an already-sharp frame.

Sequencing with the newest-wins gate: the follow-up rides the
intermediate request as followUpMaxDim; the render pump offers it
through the new RenderGate.offerIfEmpty ONLY after the intermediate
publishes and ONLY into an empty pending slot —
changed: feat: progressive pause settle to full res
